<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using a representative flavanone SMILES (O=C1C(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3=CC=CC=C3O1). The reaction breaks ketones and aromatic hydroxyls, forms ether oxygens, creates a C‑C bond (6‑6) and a C‑O bond (6‑8), and breaks a C‑O bond (6‑8). This matches the described cyclization of chalcones to flavanones.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=C1C(C2=CC=CC=C2)C3=CC=CC=C3O1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "aromatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ether oxygens"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6", "6-8"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
